environmentProbe.note: LexiCoil pipeline/product AI uses Anthropic/Gemini/Groq/xAI/ElevenLabs — not OpenAI. Realtime voice requires a separate OpenAI Platform account/key.

accessRequirements.provider: OpenAI Platform (platform.openai.com) — distinct from Gemini/Anthropic already in use
accessRequirements.freeTierRealtime: Not supported (docs: gpt-realtime-mini Free = Not supported)

concreteNextSteps: 1. Create or open an OpenAI Platform org at https://platform.openai.com
2. Billing → purchase ≥$5 API credits (Tier 1 unlocks Realtime)
3. Limits page: confirm org is Tier 1+ and gpt-realtime-mini is listed
4. Create an API key; set OPENAI_API_KEY in local .env (and Netlify when building)
5. Re-run Phase 0 probe: short PTT WebSocket session with Alex instructions + turn_detection null

personaReady.instructions: Du bist Alex, ein ausgewogener Prüfungspartner im Goethe-Zertifikat B1 Sprechen. Antworte natürlich (2–4 Sätze). Stelle Fragen und reagiere fair. Bleibe auf B1-Niveau. Antworte nur auf Deutsch.

decisionGate: Do NOT start building production Realtime Sprechen until Phase 0 live call succeeds with measured cost/latency.
